no_adcom_quote.quote: An advisory committee was not held for this application. It did not raise challenging efficacy or safety issues that needed external input.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA 213969 (Zokinvy/lonafarnib). The Integrated Review's Advisory Committee Summary states an advisory committee was not held because the application did not raise challenging efficacy or safety issues requiring external input. Consequently there are no AdComm-driven linkages to changes in the approval.
